name: Hanasu
source: After the events of [url=/v45597]Karamu[/url], Raku and Nelli have settled into an uneasy truce, although Nelli struggles to trust Raku after learning about his secrets. However, their peaceful lives are disrupted by a new arrival: Raku’s family.
